briefdescription.para: Select with condition operator - This selects between a true value and a false value (ops #3 and #4) based on the boolean result of comparing the lhs and rhs (ops #0 and #1) of a conditional expression with the condition code in op #2, a XLenVT constant from the ISD::CondCode enum.

detaileddescription.para: The lhs and rhs are XLenVT integers. The true and false values can be integer or floating point.

briefdescription.para: Turn a pair of i<xlen>s into an even-odd register pair (untyped).

listitem.para: Input 0: i<xlen> low-order bits, for even register.
Input 1: i<xlen> high-order bits, for odd register.

briefdescription.para: Turn an even-odd register pair (untyped) into a pair of i<xlen>s.

listitem.para: Output 0: i<xlen> low-order bits, from even register.
Output 1: i<xlen> high-order bits, from odd register.

briefdescription.para: Turns a pair of i32s into an f64.

detaileddescription.para:
Needed for rv32d/ilp32.
Output: f64.
Input 0: low-order bits (31-0) (as i32), for even register.
Input 1: high-order bits (63-32) (as i32), for odd register.

briefdescription.para: Turns a f64 into a pair of i32s.

detaileddescription.para:
Needed for rv32d/ilp32.
Output 0: low-order bits (31-0) (as i32), from even register.
Output 1: high-order bits (63-32) (as i32), from odd register.
Input 0: f64.
